ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems t hinking - which,in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但利用机器学习和人工智能,一些科学家提出人类的饮食至少包括26,000个生化物质 — — 而绝大多数是未知的。 这表明,我们在实现“吸食系统”这一首要目标之前有某种途径可以旅行 — — 在这个例子中,这是为了确定营养系统中更多的组成部分。

ex.s: Machines can detect fake reviews accurately.
ex.t: 机器可以准确检测假评论.

ex.s: What Hammond is referring to is the question of meaning and meaning is central to what distinguishes the least intelligent of humans from the most intelligent of machines.
ex.t: 哈蒙德所指的是意义问题,意义是区别人类中最不聪明的人和最聪明的机器的核心.

ex.s: It is this that distinguishes humans from machines.
ex.t: 这就是人类与机器的区别。

ex.s: If the field of ALife manages to reproduce life’s endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly inventive machines.
ex.t: 如果Lilife的领域能够在某些虚拟模型中复制生命的无尽的“创造力 ” , 那么同样的原则就会产生真正的发明机器。

ex.s: The researchers believe that the findings could help technology companies develop better machines that use air to do their jobs, as suction has long been used in robotics to grab objects.
ex.t: 研究者认为,这些发现可以帮助技术公司开发出更好的机器,利用空气来完成他们的工作,因为吸积早就在机器人中被用来抓物体.

ex.s: Machines have largely taken over planting, watering and harvesting crops such as com and wheat, but the monitoring of cattle has gone through fewer changes.
ex.t: 机器基本上接管了Com和小麦等作物的种植,浇水和收割,但牛的监控经历了较少的变化.

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D印刷的新领域开始成为焦点:食品。最近的发展使得机器可以大规模地印刷、烹饪和供应食品。工业并没有停止。

ex.s: If we are not careful, then, we could face a kind of global chess match against very determined, super intelligent machines whose objectives conflict with our own, with the real world as the chessboard.
ex.t: 如果我们不小心,那么,我们就可以面对一种全球围棋比赛,对抗那些目标与我们自己的,以现实世界为棋盘的极具决心的超级智能机器。

ex.s: There are probably decades in which to plan for the arrival of super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可能还有几十年的时间来规划超级智能机器的到来.

ex.s: Others say we can just “switch them off” as if super intelligent machines are too stupid to think of that possibility.
ex.t: 其他人说,我们可以“把他们甩掉”,仿佛超级智能机器太愚蠢,无法想象这种可能性。

ex.s: Machines with specific purposes are associated with living things partly because they might be able to        .
ex.t: 具有特定目的的机器与生物有关,部分原因是它们可能有能力。

ex.s: keep machines from being harmed
ex.t: 让机器不受伤害

ex.s: What does the author think of the safety problem of super intelligent machines?
ex.t: 作者对超级智能机器的安全问题有什么看法?.

ex.s: She goes back and forth between machines to make the drinks. _____37_____ As the customer grabs the drink from her hand, she smiles and says, “Hello, how is your day?” Even when the line is getting longer, she doesn’t let it get in the way of her genuine conversations.
ex.t: 当顾客从她手上拿起饮料时, 她笑着说, “你好, 今天过得如何? ” 。 即使电话线越来越长, 她也不会让它妨碍她真正的对话。

ex.s: I jumped out of the car, made a mad run for the machine, and popped my card in, only to read the message: "Out of order.
ex.t: 我跳出车来,为机器疯狂奔跑,还弹出我的名片进来,只读到留言:"出轨了.

ex.s: A machine can now not only beat you at chess, it can also outperform you in debate.
ex.t: 机器现在不仅能在棋局上击败你, 在争论中它也能比你表现好.

ex.s: The story begins in the last years of the 18th century in Scotland, where Watt perfected "the machine that changed the world".
ex.t: 故事开始于18世纪苏格兰的最后几年,瓦特完善了"改变世界的机器".

ex.s: Machine learning can solve the nutrition problem.
ex.t: 机器学习可以解决营养问题.

ex.s: 9. —The machine is working again!
ex.t: 9. 机器又在工作了!

ex.s: One may wonder how the Silence Machine works.
ex.t: 人们可能会怀疑沉默机器是如何运作的.

ex.s: Simply turn the machine or point it at the target, and your peace and quiet comes back.
ex.t: 只要把机器转动或者指向目标, 你的平静和安静就会回来.

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这给一个儿童聚会带来了乐趣;他们喜欢把水果和冰冻香蕉喂进机器的顶部,看着冰激凌从下面出来。

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.
ex.t: 具有特定目的的机器有另一种品质,一种我们通常与生物联系在一起的品质:一种保存自身存在的愿望.

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对于机器来说,这种品质不是内生的,也不是人类引入的东西;它是机器如果死了就无法达到最初目的的简单事实的逻辑后果.

ex.s: The Time Machine A faint blue light shot across it, darkening to purple, and presently she could see the image of her son, who lived on the other side of the earth, and he could see her.
ex.t: 时空机器A 微弱的蓝光射穿它, 变暗成紫色, 目前她可以看到她的儿子的形象, 她住在地球的另一边, 他可以看到她。

ex.s: The Machine Stops Instead of being printed, the Earth Chronicle is every morning spoken to subscribers, who, in interesting conversations with reporters, statesmen, and scientists, learn the news of the day.
ex.t: "机器停止"(The Machine Stops)没有被印刷,而是每天早上"地球纪事"(Earth Chronicle)向订阅者发表演讲,在与记者,政治家和科学家的有趣谈话中,他们了解到当日的消息.

ex.s: In addition, important advances have been made in machine and environmental science thanks to increasing computer power.
ex.t: 此外,由于计算机功率的提高,机器和环境科学也取得了重要进展.

ex.s: Some researchers argue that we can seal the machines inside a kind of firewall, using them to answer difficult questions but never allowing them to affect the real world.
ex.t: 一些研究者认为,我们可以把机器封在某种防火墙内,用它们回答困难的问题,但绝不允许它们影响现实世界.

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 不幸的是,该计划似乎不可能奏效:我们尚未发明一个针对普通人类的安全防火墙,更不用说超级智能机器了。

ex.s: Some argue that humans and machines can coexist as long as they work in teams—yet that is not possible unless machines share the goals of humans.
ex.t: 有些人认为,只要人类和机器在团队中工作,它们就能够共存——除非机器与人类的目标相同,否则这是不可能的。

ex.s: help super intelligent machines work better
ex.t: 帮助超级智能机器更好地工作

ex.s: Thanks to the Silence Machine, a British invention, you can get rid of the sound without upsetting the boy or his parents.
ex.t: 感谢英国发明的沉默机器,你可以摆脱声音而不令男孩或他的父母难过.

ex.t: 这是大家真正想知道的:是否有人发明过时光机?
